description: C3 evaluation report omits required median/p95 latency summary and a truthful latency-target outcome. reviewer-live-verification.ts returns passed=true for nine valid synthetic 19000ms responses despite the documented median<8000/p95<18000 targets. Add bounded aggregate latency metrics/explicit target status, keep dry-run unavailable, and prevent broad passed/CLI output from implying all declared targets passed; verify with deterministic injected-clock assertions. Evidence is reporting-path only, not live provider latency.
